subject: 44 Bradley Avenue Single Home Historic District
overview: The Historic District Commission reviewed application certificates for properties on Grandview Avenue and voted to advance a single-home historic district designation for 44 Bradley Avenue.

items.title: Certificate of Appropriateness: 36 Grandview Ave
items.summary: Approved an application to replace first-floor windows and convert an unused side door into a window, with the condition that window 108 be replaced with double-hung windows instead of a single picture window.

items.title: Single Home Historic District: 44 Bradley Ave
items.summary: Voted to proceed with establishing a single-home local historic district designation for 44 Bradley Ave and agreed to schedule a board site visit prior to the next meeting.

items.title: Certificate of Applicability: 8 Grandview Ave
items.summary: Voted that a proposed six-inch shift of a planned garage door is non-applicable because the alteration is not visible from the public way.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and Guidelines Discussion
items.summary: Postponed approval of the October meeting minutes to December and agreed to begin reviewing and updating commission guidelines.
